Nice to meet you, and thank you for your time.
I saw your character art and thought it was wonderful, so I’d like to place an order.

The character is the younger sister of my original pair of sisters, and I’d like to request this if possible.

Nami Hayagumo, born in 1998, age 21
In the Muv-Luv universe, she was born somewhere in the Soviet Union as an artificial PK (Projection-type) manifestant.
She can read people’s strong emotions. (She cannot read casual, everyday thoughts.) She can send out thought forms (ghosts?) to interfere with events at a distance and can rarely glimpse the near future, but she cannot significantly alter events.
She is not a Guardian but rather a member of the Communications and Nursing departments.

Height: 158 cm
Bust: 85 cm (C–D cup)
Waist: 55 cm
Hips: 86 cm

She takes after her father and is incredibly kind to everyone; she excels at supporting and backing up others.
She is not a guard, and she has always been physically weak with little stamina. However, she is quite capable at healing others and as an electronic warfare operator.
She has a personality that prioritizes others over herself.

I’d like her maid outfit to have no skirt or underwear underneath, giving it a slightly risqué feel.
Here are my specific requests:
・Please depict her with a gentle gaze and a bright red blush. (As if she’s looking at me—the “ghost”—off-screen.)
・For her hairstyle, please use a loose side ponytail with her hair falling over her left shoulder and near her neck.
・For the hair accessories, please include one ring-shaped clip near her cheek and tie her hair back with a ribbon just above her chest.

As an example, I’ve included a link to a reference image related to military uniforms below. Thank you for your cooperation.

Please check the attached reference materials for details.


If possible, I’d really appreciate it.
